In this notebook, I will compute cell-cell interactions with MultiNicheNet. 

Senders and receivers are based on cell states in the abundance correlation networks. Will go one level up in annotation or group cell states as necessary

Analysis will largely be based on this vignette:
https://github.com/saeyslab/multinichenetr/blob/main/vignettes/basic_analysis_steps_MISC.knit.md

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(nichenetr)
library(multinichenetr)
library(ggrepel)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
colIBD <- "#EB6D33"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

# From RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12,)
annoColVec <- c("IBDAssocEpi" = "#FB8072", "Venule" = "#8DD3C7", "IBDAssocFibro" = "#80B1D3", 
                "IBDAssocMonoMac" = "#B3DE69", "IgGPC" = "#BEBADA", "GALTB" = "#FCCDE5",
                "Thelper" = "#FDB462", "Tfh" = "#BC80BD", "Treg" = "#FFFFB3", "NK" = "#D9D9D9")

nichenetannoVec <- names(annoColVec)

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

source("../functions/FeaturesFilter.R")
```

## Ligand Receptor Network

```{r}
lr_network_all <- 
  readRDS(url(
    "https://zenodo.org/record/10229222/files/lr_network_human_allInfo_30112033.rds"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    ligand = convert_alias_to_symbols(ligand, organism = "human"), 
    receptor = convert_alias_to_symbols(receptor, organism = "human"))

lr_network_all <- lr_network_all  %>% 
  mutate(ligand = make.names(ligand), receptor = make.names(receptor)) 

lr_network <- lr_network_all %>% 
  distinct(ligand, receptor)

ligand_target_matrix <- readRDS(url(
  "https://zenodo.org/record/7074291/files/ligand_target_matrix_nsga2r_final.rds"
))

colnames(ligand_target_matrix) <- colnames(ligand_target_matrix) %>% 
  convert_alias_to_symbols(organism = "human") %>% make.names()
rownames(ligand_target_matrix) <- rownames(ligand_target_matrix) %>% 
  convert_alias_to_symbols(organism = "human") %>% make.names()

lr_network <- lr_network %>% filter(ligand %in% colnames(ligand_target_matrix))
ligand_target_matrix <- ligand_target_matrix[, lr_network$ligand %>% unique()]
```

```{r}
lr_network
lr_network$ligand %>% n_distinct
lr_network$receptor %>% n_distinct
ligand_target_matrix %>% dim
```

## SingleCellExperiment Object

```{r}
seuobj <- readRDS("data/objects/annotated/predictCOL__CB_allcells_annotated_251017_v4.rds")
seuobj
```

```{r}
seuobj <- AddMetaData(
  seuobj,
  seuobj@meta.data %>% 
    mutate(nichenetanno = case_when(
      cellstate %in% c("Inflm. Col.", "Inflm. Gob.", "CCL24+ Gob.", "LGR5+ Epi.", "SAA+ Epi.") ~ "IBDAssocEpi",
      cellstate == "Venule" ~ "Venule",
      cellstate %in% c("TFPI2Hi Fibro.", "PDPNHi Fibro.") ~ "IBDAssocFibro",
      cellstate %in% c("Inflm. Mac", "MNP") ~ "IBDAssocMonoMac",
      cellsubtype == "IgG" ~ "IgGPC",
      cellsubtype == "GALTB" ~ "GALTB",
      cellsubtype == "Thelper" ~ "Thelper",
      cellsubtype == "Tfh" ~ "Tfh",
      cellsubtype == "Treg" ~ "Treg",
      cellsubtype == "NK" ~ "NK"
    )) %>% 
    mutate(nichenetanno = fct_relevel(nichenetanno, c(
      nichenetannoVec
    ))) %>% 
    mutate(biopsy = make.names(biopsy)) %>% 
    mutate(biopsy = fct_relevel(biopsy, sort(unique(biopsy))))
)

seuobj@meta.data %>% distinct(celltype, cellsubtype, cellstate, nichenetanno) %>% arrange(cellstate)
seuobj@meta.data %>% distinct(celltype, cellsubtype, cellstate, nichenetanno) %>% arrange(cellstate) %>% filter(!is.na(nichenetanno))
```

```{r}
seuobj.tosce <- subset(seuobj, subset = nichenetanno %in% nichenetannoVec & 
                         timepoint == "T0" & diagSub %notin% c("FGID", "iCD"))
seuobj.tosce
seuobj.tosce@meta.data %>% distinct(celltype, cellsubtype, cellstate, nichenetanno) %>% arrange(cellstate)

seuobj.tosce$biopsy <- droplevels(seuobj.tosce$biopsy)
seuobj.tosce$timepoint <- droplevels(seuobj.tosce$timepoint)
seuobj.tosce$diagSub <- droplevels(seuobj.tosce$diagSub)
seuobj.tosce$nichenetanno <- droplevels(seuobj.tosce$nichenetanno)
```

```{r}
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seuobj.tosce, assay = "RNA")
sce
```

```{r}
logFC_threshold <-  0.50
p_val_threshold <- 0.05

p_val_adj <- FALSE 

geneset_assessment <- contrast_tbl$contrast %>% 
  lapply(
    process_geneset_data, 
    celltype_de, logFC_threshold, p_val_adj, p_val_threshold
  ) %>% 
  bind_rows() 

geneset_assessment %>% arrange(cluster_id)
```

```{r, fig.width=18, fig.height=14}
thisgroup <- "UC"
thiscontrast <- "UC-cCD"
thiscontrast.title <- "UC vs. cCD"
upCol <- colUC
downCol <- colcCD

uptext <- paste("Upregulated in", thisgroup)
downtext <- paste("Downregulated in", thisgroup)
thisColVec <- c(downCol,"gray50",upCol)
names(thisColVec) <- c(downtext, "Not DE", uptext)

for(thiscluster in unique(celltype_de$cluster_id)){
  
  thisdf <- celltype_de %>% 
    filter(cluster_id == thiscluster & contrast == thiscontrast) %>% 
    mutate(labelname = ifelse(p_val <= p_val_threshold & abs(logFC) >= logFC_threshold, gene, NA)) %>% 
    mutate(timepoint = ifelse(sign(logFC) == 1, uptext, downtext)) %>% 
    mutate(timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c(downtext, uptext))) %>% 
    mutate(pointfill = ifelse(p_val <= p_val_threshold, as.character(timepoint), "Not DE")) %>% 
    mutate(pointfill = fct_relevel(pointfill, c(downtext, "Not DE", uptext))) %>%
    mutate(facetLabel = thiscluster)
  
  thisplot <- ggplot(thisdf, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(p_val), label = labelname)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_val_threshold), lty = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = logFC_threshold, lty = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -logFC_threshold, lty = 2) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", size = 4, aes(fill = pointfill)) +
  geom_point(data = . %>% 
               filter(row_number() %in% c(1,2,3)) %>%
               mutate(dummy = fct_inorder(c(downtext, 
                                            "Not DE", 
                                            uptext))),
             aes(fill = dummy), 
             alpha = 0, size = 0, shape = 21) +
  geom_label_repel(aes(color = pointfill), label.padding = 0.1, label.size = 2, seed = thisseed,
                   fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = 50, alpha=0.7, size = 4.5, show.legend = F) +
  geom_label_repel(color = "black", label.padding = 0.1, label.size = 0, seed = thisseed,
                   fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = 50, alpha=0.7, size = 4.5, show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = thisColVec,
                    limits = c(downtext, "Not DE", uptext),
                    labels = c(downtext, "Not DE", uptext),
                    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 4))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = thisColVec) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~facetLabel, scales = "fixed", nrow = 2) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(
    -(thisdf$logFC %>% range %>% abs %>% max %>% ceiling),
    thisdf$logFC %>% range %>% abs %>% max %>% ceiling
  )) +
  labs(
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    size = "Average Expression",
    x = "Average Log2 FC",
    y = "-Log10 P Value (Unadjusted)",
    title = thiscontrast.title
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold")
  )
  plot(thisplot)
}
```

## Network

### Unbiased

```{r}
pearsonVal <- 0.35

group_oi <- c("cCD", "UC")

lr_target_prior_cor_filtered.ccduc <- 
  multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables$group_prioritization_tbl$group %>% unique() %>% 
  lapply(function(group_oi){
    lr_target_prior_cor_filtered = multinichenet_output$lr_target_prior_cor %>%
      inner_join(
        multinichenet_output$ligand_activities_targets_DEgenes$ligand_activities %>%
          distinct(ligand, target, direction_regulation, contrast)
        ) %>% 
      inner_join(contrast_tbl) %>% filter(group == group_oi)
    
    lr_target_prior_cor_filtered_up = lr_target_prior_cor_filtered %>% 
      filter(direction_regulation == "up") %>% 
      filter( (rank_of_target < top_n_target) & (pearson > pearsonVal))
    
    lr_target_prior_cor_filtered_down = lr_target_prior_cor_filtered %>% 
      filter(direction_regulation == "down") %>% 
      filter( (rank_of_target < top_n_target) & (pearson < -pearsonVal))
    lr_target_prior_cor_filtered = bind_rows(
      lr_target_prior_cor_filtered_up, 
      lr_target_prior_cor_filtered_down
      )
}) %>% bind_rows()
lr_target_prior_cor_filtered.ccduc

lr_target_df.ccduc <- lr_target_prior_cor_filtered.ccduc %>% 
  distinct(group, sender, receiver, ligand, receptor, id, target, direction_regulation) 
lr_target_df.ccduc
```

  group_data = prioritization_tables$ligand_activities_target_de_tbl %>% 
    dplyr::inner_join(contrast_tbl) %>% dplyr::distinct(group, 
    ligand, receiver, activity, activity_scaled, direction_regulation) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(ligand %in% ligands_oi) %>% dplyr::mutate(group_direction_regulation = paste(group, 
    direction_regulation, sep = "-"))
  p1 = group_data %>% ggplot(aes(receiver, ligand, fill = activity_scaled)) + 
    geom_tile(color = "whitesmoke") + facet_grid(. ~ group_direction_regulation, 
    scales = "free", space = "free") + scale_x_discrete(position = "top") + 
    theme_light() + theme(axis.ticks = element_blank(), 
    axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold.italic", 
      size = 9), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, 
      angle = 90, hjust = 0), strip.text.x.top = element_text(angle = 0), 
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.2, "lines"), panel.spacing.y = unit(0.25, 
      "lines"), strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10, 
      color = "black", face = "bold"), strip.text.y = element_blank(), 
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "darkgrey", 
      fill = "whitesmoke", size = 1.5, linetype = "solid")) + 
    labs(fill = "Scaled Ligand\nActivity in Receiver")
  max_activity = abs(group_data$activity_scaled) %>% max(na.rm = TRUE)
  custom_scale_fill = scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white", 
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "PuRd") %>% .[-7]), 
    values = c(0, 0.51, 0.575, 0.625, 0.675, 0.725, 1), 
    limits = c(-1 * max_activity, max_activity))
  p1 = p1 + custom_scale_fill
  p2 = group_data %>% ggplot(aes(receiver, ligand, fill = activity)) + 
    geom_tile(color = "whitesmoke") + facet_grid(. ~ group_direction_regulation, 
    scales = "free", space = "free") + scale_x_discrete(position = "top") + 
    theme_light() + theme(axis.ticks = element_blank(), 
    axis.title = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
    axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, 
      angle = 90, hjust = 0), strip.text.x.top = element_text(angle = 0), 
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.2, "lines"), panel.spacing.y = unit(0.25, 
      "lines"), strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10, 
      color = "black", face = "bold"), strip.text.y = element_blank(), 
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "darkgrey", 
      fill = "whitesmoke", size = 1.5, linetype = "solid")) + 
    labs(fill = "Ligand\nActivity in Receiver")
  max_activity = (group_data$activity) %>% max()
  min_activity = (group_data$activity) %>% min()
  custom_scale_fill = scale_fill_gradient2(low = "white", 
    mid = "white", high = "darkorange", midpoint = 0)
  p2 = p2 + custom_scale_fill
  if (!is.null(widths)) {
    p = patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, nrow = 1, guides = "collect", 
      widths = widths)
  } else {
    p = p1 + p2
  }
  p
